import json, sys
items = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
subtotal = sum(item['price'] * item['quantity'] for item in items)
print(json.dumps({"subtotal": subtotal}))

import json, sys
data = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
subtotal = data['subtotal']
tier = data['tier']
discount = 0
if tier == 'gold':
    discount = subtotal * 0.15
elif tier == 'silver':
    discount = subtotal * 0.10
elif tier == 'bronze':
    discount = subtotal * 0.05
total = subtotal - discount
print(json.dumps({"discount": discount, "total_after_discount": total}))

Metadata.Description: Calculate tax based on shipping address

args:
import json, sys
data = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
total = data['total_after_discount']
state = data['shipping_address']['state']
tax_rates = {'CA': 0.0825, 'NY': 0.08, 'TX': 0.0625, 'FL': 0.06}
rate = tax_rates.get(state, 0.05)
tax = total * rate
grand_total = total + tax
print(json.dumps({"tax": tax, "grand_total": grand_total, "tax_rate": rate}))
